cachepipeline.offer.text: smith can set the secret variables in your Azure Pipelines pipeline for you. It reads the git remote and runs az to read the pipeline. It writes nothing until you confirm, and a secret never appears on a command line.
cachepipeline.offer.prompt: Set the variables in Azure Pipelines from here?
cachepipeline.offer.yes.hint: runs `git remote get-url origin` and read-only az commands
cachepipeline.offer.no: No, I will do it by hand
cachepipeline.offer.no.hint: the steps follow at the end
cachepipeline.az.missing: `az` is not installed here, so smith cannot set the variables. The manual steps follow at the end.
cachepipeline.git.working: Reading the git remote: git remote get-url origin
cachepipeline.git.none: smith could not read the git remote `origin`, so it cannot find the pipeline. The manual steps follow at the end.
cachepipeline.git.other: The git remote `origin` is not an Azure DevOps address, so smith cannot find the pipeline. The manual steps follow at the end.
cachepipeline.signin.text: Nobody is signed in to az. Signing in opens your browser or asks you:
cachepipeline.signin.no: I will do it by hand
cachepipeline.signin.no.hint: run nothing; the manual steps follow at the end
cachepipeline.signin.failed: `az login` failed: {error}. The manual steps follow at the end.
cachepipeline.extension.missing: az has no Azure DevOps extension. Run `az extension add --name azure-devops`, then run this setup again. The manual steps follow at the end.
cachepipeline.az.failed: `az` failed: {error}. The manual steps follow at the end.
cachepipeline.pipelines.none: The project {project} has no pipeline for the repository {repository}. Create the pipeline first. The manual steps follow at the end.
cachepipeline.pipelines.skip: None, I will do it by hand
cachepipeline.pipelines.skip.hint: the steps follow at the end
cachepipeline.exists.prompt: {name} already exists in the pipeline {pipeline}. What should smith do with it?
cachepipeline.exists.replace.hint: the pipeline gets the new value; a machine that holds the old value stops matching
cachepipeline.exists.leave.hint: nothing changes in Azure for this variable
cachepipeline.exists.left: {name} stays as it is in the pipeline {pipeline}.
cachepipeline.action.label: set it in Azure Pipelines (az)
cachepipeline.done.created: {name} is created as a secret variable of the pipeline {pipeline}. smith ci generate already maps it into the steps with env:, because Azure shows a secret to a step only that way.
cachepipeline.done.replaced: {name} is replaced in the pipeline {pipeline}. smith ci generate already maps it into the steps with env:.
cachepipeline.exists.meanwhile: {name} exists in the pipeline {pipeline} now. smith changed nothing. Press the key again to replace it, or leave it.
cachepipeline.failed: smith could not set {name}: {error}. Nothing else changed. The manual steps follow at the end.
cachepipeline.done.page: Set from here in the pipeline {pipeline} (organisation {organization}, project {project}): {names}. They are secret variables. The steps below are only for what is left.
